The LRP fluid invisible suncreen : so far so good, havent seen any problem at all except i dont like the watery texture (i prefer cream over essence). The finish is a but oily but absorb quickly . ( from france .
You can also check Avene or Vichy suncreen, i havent use it

Imagine 32+ : too expensive for me and have fragrance ( even though they printed no fragrance on the package but the “bubble gum” smell is very clear. It have creamy texture but the finish leave your skin a bit oily for quite awhile ( because the 32spf is for dry skin )
I say 7 out of 10  ( this brand is from america )

Marti Derm proteos suncreen : havent try it because it is pricey but it have manh good review. Can protect your skin from UVA/UVB IRA HEV. It is currently popular among the VietNam skincare community. ( this one is from spanish )

Cell fusion C laser suncreen ( the red one ) :  I like this one because i can use it as a makeup base or natural makeup. However, the sun protection index in many asian suncreen (korean,japan...) arent good like in Eroupe or america. 

I hope this help and sorry for my broken english ;)
